subtitle: Lesson 13 · Filtering and Sorting

eyebrow: AND — every condition must be true
caption: A row survives only if BOTH conditions hold.

eyebrow: OR — at least one must be true
caption: A row survives if EITHER condition holds.
Where color is NOT red — same idea as Color <> 'Red'.

code:
-- AND evaluates FIRST — this really means:
-- Red, OR (Blue AND expensive)
WHERE Color = 'Red' OR Color = 'Blue'
  AND ListPrice > 500;
caption: Every red product sneaks in regardless of price.
Parentheses make the grouping explicit — always use them when mixing AND/OR.
